analysis.summary: Shanti Gold International Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue growth driven by volume expansion and the commencement of operations at the new Marol manufacturing facility. Management stated a full-year top-line guidance of 50% to 60% growth and volume growth of 30% to 40%, while maintaining a constructive long-term outlook on the organized jewellery market and gold prices. The company also announced a rights issue of up to INR100 crores and noted upcoming operational capacity expansion in Jaipur. Furthermore, management projected normalized EBITDA margins to be around 7.5% to 8% for the year after adjusting for unrealized inventory gains in Q1. Shanti Gold International Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27 and FY26, highlighting significant growth in revenue, profit, and manufacturing capacity.

guidance.claim: Management maintains a full-year top-line guidance of 50% to 60% growth.
guidance.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

guidance.claim: The company guides for a volume growth of 30% to 40% compared to last year.
guidance.quote: So, if I have to go for the volume and the value, volume will remain largely in the 30% to 40% range and the value will remain in the 50% to 60% range as compared to last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects 30% to 40% volume growth and 60% to 70% value growth in the coming year.
guidance.quote: So this year, i.e current coming year, it will be around 30% to 40% growth in terms of volume and around 60%-70% growth in terms of value

guidance.claim: Management projects a sustainable core PAT margin of approximately 4%.
guidance.quote: This margin would be around 4% and all, which we've been maintaining that 4% plus and all.

demand_outlook.claim: The outlook for the organized jewellery market remains constructive, supported by strong wedding and occasion-led demand, rising disposable incomes, and an increasing preference for organized and branded jewellery.
demand_outlook.quote: From an industry perspective, the outlook for the organized jewellery continues to remain constructive.

demand_outlook.claim: Management remains very bullish on the long-term fundamentals of gold despite short-term fluctuations.
demand_outlook.quote: So the long-term, our vision towards the gold is very, very bullish.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising disposable income drives gold as a status symbol and investment.
demand_outlook.quote:
Rising Middle Class
Growing disposable income drives gold as status symbol & investment

demand_outlook.claim: Seasonal demand arises from weddings, Diwali, and harvest festivals.
demand_outlook.quote:
Weddings & Festivals
Seasonal demand from weddings, Diwali & harvest festivals

demand_outlook.claim: Unique Indian designs attract global buyers, providing export growth potential.
demand_outlook.quote:
Export Opportunity
Unique Indian designs attracting global buyers; export growth potential

demand_outlook.claim: Branded players are driving consumer trust in the jewellery market.
demand_outlook.quote:
Organised Shift
Branded players (Tanishq, Kalyan, Malabar) driving consumer trust

demand_outlook.claim: Monthly jewellery investment schemes improve affordability.
demand_outlook.quote:
Gold Loans Access
Monthly jewellery investment schemes improve affordability

demand_outlook.claim: Demand remains resilient across key markets and customer segments despite elevated gold prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite elevated gold prices during the year, overall demand trends remained resilient across key markets and customer segments.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is witnessing an increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellery retailers.
demand_outlook.quote: One of the most encouraging trends we are witnessing today is the increasing outsourcing preference among organized jewellers, retailers, as retailers continue to focus on expanding their footprint, inventory optimizing, and faster design cycles.

capex_expansion.claim: Operations have successfully commenced at the new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to the quarter, Q1 FY27 was an important period for the company, particularly from an operational perspective, with the successful commencement of operations at our new manufacturing facility in Marol, Mumbai.

capex_expansion.claim: The upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen the company's manufacturing footprint.
capex_expansion.quote: Alongside this, the upcoming Jaipur facility will further strengthen our manufacturing footprint and support our ability to address the growing demand across markets.

capex_expansion.claim: The allotted capex for the Jaipur facility is approximately INR47 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: So capex is around INR47 crores what we have allotted for Jaipur facility, and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur factory will be spread across 3 acres of land, with the first phase spanning 50,000 square feet.
capex_expansion.quote: Jaipur factory is actually spread across 3 acres of land, and this 50,000 is just one segment of those, of the whole plant that we have.

capex_expansion.claim: The new Marol facility in Mumbai will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: our new Marol facility in Mumbai, which will add approximately 4,000 kilo per annum of manufacturing capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The Jaipur facility is expected to add 1,200 kilo per annum of capacity and is progressing as planned.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition, the 1,200 kilo per annum capacity addition announced during an IPO at Jaipur, continues to progress in line with expectations.

margins_costs.claim: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin stood at 9.97%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR71.45 crores, with an EBITDA margin of 9.97%.

margins_costs.claim: Normalized EBITDA margin for the year is expected to be in the range of 7.5% to 8%.
margins_costs.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margin for Q1 FY27 stood at 7.05 percentage.
margins_costs.quote: PAT margin for the quarter stood at 7.05 percentage.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin was 10.9% in Q1 FY27.
EBITDA margin was 10.0% in Q1 FY27.
PAT margin was 7.1% in Q1 FY27.
The company transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from FIFO to the weighted average cost method.
margins_costs.quote: The company has transitioned its inventory valuation methodology from the First In, First Out, FIFO method to the weighted average cost WAC method with retrospective effect from April 01, 2024.

orders_capacity.claim: The current capacity utilization for the Mumbai facility is 75%.
Cast-studded jewellery accounts for approximately 75% of total sales.
The existing installed capacity in Mumbai (Andheri + Marol) is approximately 6,700 kg per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Installed capacity: ~6,700 kg pa (Andheri + Marol, post commissioning)

orders_capacity.claim: Total installed capacity upon completion is projected at 7,900 kg pa.
Total installed manufacturing capacity is expected to reach nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum once new facilities are operational.
orders_capacity.quote: Once operational, this addition will take our total installed manufacturing capacity to nearly 7,900 kilogram per annum, positioning us strongly for the next phase of scalable growth.

orders_capacity.claim: Current capacity utilization at the existing factory is approximately 65%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares aggregating up to INR100 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: As part of our growth and capital planning, the company has approved a rights issue of 46,43,471 fully paid-up equity shares of face value 10 each, aggregating up to INR100 crores.
See, debt-to-equity, madam, currently we are at 0.50, which is still – we plan to go up to less than one maybe because still, as I told you, we are on a growth spree.

capital_allocation.claim: Proceeds from the rights issue will be invested completely in gold and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: So right now we -- the money what we are acquiring from rights issue is going to be invested completely in gold and working capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that May and June were quite subdued regarding market movements in gold prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: And the May and June was quite subdued.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions have caused delays in the commencement of the Dubai subsidiary.
risks_headwinds.quote: It's delayed because of the geopolitical things, otherwise everything is in place . We've taken the place, received all our license and all. Due to war, Iran and these wars are going on, that is why it's extended.

management_commitments.claim: The company maintains its top-line growth guidance of 50% to 60% and volume growth of 30% to 40% for the current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: And the top line, we stick to our guidance of around 50% to 60% growth this year.

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur facility is scheduled to become operational around mid-November or December.
management_commitments.quote: and it should be operational around November, mid-November or December, because the factory work is still going on.

management_commitments.claim: Normalized EBITDA margins are projected to be between 7.5% and 8% for the year.
management_commitments.quote: So roughly 2% to 2.5% was the inventory gain. So if you remove that percent, roughly going forward, looking at the current demand and all, we should be in the range of 7.5% to 8% EBITDA.

management_commitments.claim: The Marol facility is expected to be operational in approximately one month.
management_commitments.quote: So see, our new factory is almost ready, which is going to be like in a month or so for Marol factory

management_commitments.claim: The Jaipur factory is expected to start production by September or October 2026.
management_commitments.quote: and I guess Jaipur factory should be starting by around September, October now.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
